![](../../figures/eibis-genai.svg){fig-alt="Firms using AI and big data analytics or investing in generative AI in 2025, weighted by value added: 37% in the EU, 36% in the United States."}

The EIB reports the 37% as firms using generative AI, but its chart combines two questions: a firm counts if it has implemented AI and big data analytics, or if it invests in generative AI tools. Shares are weighted by value added, whereas Eurostat's 20% for 2025 counts each firm equally; reweighting Eurostat's data by value added gives a similar level ([Bick et al. 2026, St. Louis Fed Working Paper 2026-003B, Appendix C.1](https://doi.org/10.20955/wp.2026.003); the earlier NBER version, w34995, does not include this appendix).
